text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Academic transcript of high school5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program)6.The identity certificate of the guarantors charging your case in China For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc.
